schema_owner: Existing canonical control plane admits source, lineage, copy, rights, revocation and deletion metadata; memory store is a derived projection

integration.R-P: ContentEnvelope names preserved; complete influence union; readers/purposes intersect; current authority checked before exposure and effects
integration.R-T: Owns media_facets, representation_kind, modality selectors and media loss/counters. Extends shared ArtifactRef/ContentEnvelope, no second artifact owner
integration.R-R: Current GoalSpec, exact PlanRevision, checkpoint, source and accounting references only. Wakes resolve them afresh; memory never executes a remembered plan
integration.R-H: Output-category-specific retention/replay/redisplay restrictions are admission inputs; transport ownership confers no blanket rights

fields.object_type: string: existing canonical object or artifact type
fields.content_digest: exact bytes integrity identity; internal project trust domain only

ArtifactRef.external_representation: audience-scoped opaque_handle with fresh authorization; do not expose content_digest or globally correlated stable ids
ArtifactRef.integrity_nonproof: Digest proves only matching bytes under chosen algorithm assumptions, not authentic origin or authority

ContentEnvelope.extensions_owner: R-T for media facets; extensions cannot weaken base restrictions

fields.schema_revision: versioned closed record schema; reject unknown security-relevant fields
fields.memory_id: opaque identifier unique inside its privacy domain
fields.memory_revision: immutable version; never mutate source meaning in place
fields.claim: bounded typed payload; a source assertion is not established truth
fields.canonical_input_cursor: exact input cut; never a writer permit
fields.canonical_evidence_refs: ArtifactRef[] pointing to admitted observation/source receipts
fields.canonical_decision_ref: ArtifactRef or null; mandatory for a current accepted-decision claim; resolved separately
fields.goal_ref: exact current GoalSpec reference used for applicability; cannot authorize
fields.plan_ref: exact PlanRevision reference or null; no independent plan object
fields.accounting_ref: canonical accounting projection reference; not a second meter or budget
fields.project_id: current scope identifier; path and repository name are not identity
fields.goal_scope: exact allowed goals and applicability conditions
fields.privacy_domain_id: scope for internal digest and identity interpretation
fields.project_and_audience: explicit project, audience and actual intended recipient binding
fields.allowed_readers: intersection of source restrictions and current policy; no default wildcard
fields.allowed_purposes: intersection; null means unknown and protected use refused
fields.confidentiality_class: inherited conservative label set; incomparable labels remain conjunctive
fields.integrity_class: separate source/authenticity evidence; cannot be derived from confidentiality
fields.authenticated_origin_or_unknown: verified origin reference or null with reason
fields.capturing_actor_ref: identity of admitted producer; no provider credential
fields.source_kind: original artifact, tool observation, visible conversation, imported file or derived artifact
fields.source_locator: R-T shared text/media selector or source-unit reference; never automatically public
fields.observed_at: source observation time with timezone/clock quality
fields.recorded_at: canonical admission time, separately from source valid time
fields.valid_time: from/until interval or explicit unknown; same subject can have disjoint intervals
fields.observed_input_set: ArtifactRef[] of all possibly influential inputs visible to transform, not only citations
fields.transform_identity_version_config: exact transform identity, version/config and admitted execution receipt; no hidden reasoning
fields.coverage_and_loss: omitted/truncated/uncertain fields and semantic-loss declarations, plus verification references
fields.revocation_lookup_ref: current canonical revocation resolver reference; local flag alone is insufficient
fields.supersedes_refs: ArtifactRef[] under declared comparable lineage and scope
fields.retention_rights: policy reference plus capture/index/embed/summarize/cache/export/replay/redisplay purposes, allowed destinations, expiry and notices; unknown denies protected action
fields.lineage_registration_ref: canonical metadata receipt required before publication
fields.copy_inventory_refs: copy-ledger entries for all known controlled/external copies
fields.disclosure_refs: exact recipient-bound exposure operations and evidence; no retroactive erasure promise
fields.projection_generation: derived generation and committed registration receipt; a cache identity is not authority
fields.unknown_fields: field-to-reason map; never coerce unknown to zero, false or empty proof

rules: Possible-influence graph over immutable revisions is acyclic; alias/same-subject relations separate
Model-selected citations cannot remove possibly influential inputs
Unknown inputs or omitted copy classes prevent completeness
Rebuild must create a newly checked envelope even when reusable evidence bytes do not change

CopyRecord.no_empty_default: An unknown class is not equivalent to zero copies

DisclosureRecord.rule: Immutable fact of prior disclosure may remain under restricted policy; cannot imply erasure of human knowledge or uncontrolled copies

completion_predicates: Closed expected copy-class inventory at fenced cut
No new in-scope derivative admitted after fence
Every descendant accounted or explicitly blocked
Every relevant controlled payload and key-recovery path resolved under approved method
No unresolved external/offline copy in the claim scope
Independent evidence acceptance binds exact inventory and current policy
DeletionRequest.controlled_milestone: controlled_lineage_verified is a bounded milestone only, never global verified_complete

steps: Recheck exact recipient and compiled bytes at dispatch
RetrievalRequest.ranking: Eligibility then canonical source class then independent support/confirmation then relevance/valid-time proximity; usage is never confidence

nonblocking_rules: No model/index scan/remote wait inside canonical writer lock
Finite memory queue, bounded rejection/defer and lag state
Lost ACK reconciles original operation id

non_authority_invariants: For same exact request and canonical state, arbitrary memory changes cannot alter authorization
No new grant fields allowed in memory payload schema
Source provenance and signature are evidence not permission
Fork copies admissible evidence, not live lease/reservation/approval
accounting_invariant: Use existing cumulative canonical budget formula. Preserve consumed and reserved liabilities and uncertainty as defined there; uncertainty may annotate retained reservation and is not added again. Strict-cap admission refuses when required upper bound is unknown.
unknown_reason: No memory target execution, model or provider call in this lane
retention_invariant: Every input restriction constrains the derivative. Use earliest binding expiry unless separately reviewed rights permit different derivative retention; summarization, embedding, retrieval and re-observation never reset the clock. Unknown required expiry policy blocks protected use.
